pattern.name: Woodland oak canopy
pattern.description: Sparse oak twigs and gentle lobed leaf silhouettes along the upper-right and lower-right margins; quiet woodland habitat behind the squirrel portrait.

framing.note: Native 1024x1024 portrait retained without scaling or recoloring; lower-left neck and shoulder enter the frame intentionally while the ears and muzzle keep positive clearance from the top and right edges.

matte.calibrationNote: Pass 02 lowers minimumChannel from 244 to 235 (chroma <= 18, edgeBand 3) to decontaminate 1px JPEG boundary ringing at ear tufts and chin on dark surfaces while keeping the lightest cream throat facet ([251,243,224], low 224, chroma 27) untouched.
